notes.title: Introducing a new major update
notes.content:
After more than a year with no updates, Valhall 2000 in back. We've been working hard for a while with our hands deep in code, and return with a revamped UI that is a lot more convenient, in addition to new features such as the new game mode Adventure, where you can compete either alone or in a team in a bunch of new maps, of course still with the possibility for user created content.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29360467/bb7981434c019db75e0c9c5333f01fa689824b14.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29360467/bec5f48bf31e32fce5222ba6aed859738c546038.png[/img][/url]

We've also fixed many a few things here and there which overall should make the whole experience of playing a small bit smoother.

Please enjoy and have fun in the world of Valhall 2000.
